name: timeout_no_fallback
description: C1's no-fallback path, offline: the model times out on every attempt. scal must produce NO answer — chat() raises after its 5 attempts; the /api/chat route (which retries transient errors 5x on top, so 25 provider attempts per request — a retry budget this scenario exposes) returns status 'error' with a processing-error reply and zero fitted-parameter shapes — and must not try another provider or invent anything.
